name: Couchbase - DCP Queues
description: The Couchbase -  DCP Queues dashboard provides an insight into the DCP queues of buckets in couchbase clusters: the number of DCP connections, DCP senders, the number of items in DCP Queues.
title: Couchbase - DCP Queues
